testo:
Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Put one of them into your mana zone tapped and put the rest into your graveyard.
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone from your hand, destroy it.
Fushigiverse
